items.title: [AINews] High Taste Testers Ep. 1
items.summary: Meta 发布的 816B MoE 开源模型 Muse Spark Open 以 39 分位列美国开源模型智力指数榜首，其 NVFP4 量化版仅需 4 块 Blackwell Ultra 或 8 块 H200 GPU 即可部署，单位索引任务成本仅为 $0.84，但在此项智能体评估中排名垫底；Reflection 则推出 Apache 2.0 许可的 501B MoE 模型 Beam，支持 1M 上下文，在 4× B300 GPU 上 NVFP4 并发推理实测达到 1769 tok/s。
items.why_now: Meta 刚发布 Muse Spark Open，单任务成本仅 $0.84 且支持 Mac 本地部署，为开发者提供低成本高性能窗口。
items.why_now_en: Meta's Muse Spark Open drops open-weight MoE at $1.25/M tokens.
items.summary_en: Meta’s Muse Spark Open, an 816B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 42B active parameters, leads US open-weights models on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with a score of 39, outperforming NVIDIA’s Nemotron 3.5 Super by 13 points and offering a 1M context window served at $1.25/$4.25 per million input/output tokens. Reflection’s Beam 1.0, a 501B-parameter MoE released under Apache 2.0, ranks second among US open models with a score of 30 but trails significantly in agentic benchmarks, scoring only 3.0% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 while achieving 1,769 output tokens per second on 4x B300 GPUs using NVFP4 quantization.

items.title: Anthropic 如何在 Claude 写下 Claude Code 约 90% 代码后重新设计代码评审
items.summary: Anthropic 重构代码评审体系后，Claude Code 约 90% 代码由 Claude 生成，在 2026 年 6-9 月实现合并 PR 数量翻倍且 revert 率下降超 40%。该体系通过七层防线将“人读代码”转变为基于风险分类（低/中/高风险）的人工审批与 AI 验证结合，并利用“三轮封顶”及增量 diff 审查解决 AI 评审死循环问题，使平均评审轮次从 2.08 降至 1.32，一轮通过率提升至 78%。
items.why_now_en: Anthropic AI code review system reduces revert rate by 40% in 2026.
items.summary_en: After Claude wrote approximately 90% of the code for Claude Code, Anthropic restructured its review process into seven defense layers, including mandatory AI audits and risk-based human approvals, which doubled merged PRs and reduced revert rates by over 40% between June and September 2026. To resolve AI "infinite loop" issues where agents revisited pre-existing code, they implemented caps on review rounds and incremental diff analysis, improving one-round pass rates from 65% to 78% and reducing multi-round reviews from 8.9% to 1.5%.

items.title: 两台宇树G1组队打乒乓：PingpongDuo解锁人形机器人双打协同
items.summary: 上海创智学院、源策未来等团队提出 PingpongDuo 框架，利用联合站位规划与 PPO 强化学习让两台宇树 G1 机器人实现乒乓双打协同，使仿真中平均连续合法回球数从 3.79 次提升至 4.87 次。通过引入持拍臂残差策略并基于球交互仿真进行修正，单机器人合法回球成功率从 44.2% 提高至 55.6%，支持机器人在 2.4 秒内完成 2.15 米移动并实现 2.23 米/秒峰值速度。实机测试中，两台 G1 与人类搭档成功完成 18 次连续交替回球，验证了动态环境下多机器人安全协作的有效性。

items.title: Show HN: I Made 17 AIs Play 7,700 Hands of Poker
items.summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Muse Spark 和 GPT-6 Luna 等低成本推理 LLM 在扑克决策表现上与 GPT-6.1 Sol 和 Claude Opus 5.5 持平甚至更优，价格仅约为后者的三十分之一（如 Luna 为 $0.71/千手，Opus 为 $22/千手）。一个仅 30 行的 Python 权益模拟脚本在 100 局重复对决中击败最佳决策模型 Jev 1.13 2.7 个大盲注，并领先 Solar 5.3 个大盲注，证明简单脚本在确定性决策上优于复杂模型。此外，本地运行的波兰开源模型 Bielik 表现最差，低于随机机器且从不弃牌，而决策模型普遍出现如面对口袋对 A 弃牌等策略异常。
items.why_now: 便宜推理LLM性能对标顶级模型，成本仅为后者的30分之一。

items.title: cursor/plugins
items.summary: Cursor 官方及社区发布了一系列插件，涵盖开发工具、生产力及 SaaS 集成三大类别，每个插件均通过独立的 `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json` 清单文件进行管理。其中 “Thermos” 插件实现了基于并行子智能体的深度安全与代码质量审计，而 “Orchestrate” 则支持将大型任务分发至云端并行智能体进行规划与验证；此外，“Grok Voice” 插件集成实时语音交互功能，“pstack” 与 “dyl-stack” 则通过严谨的智能体工作流优化代码生成质量与根因分析。
items.why_now: Cursor正式开放插件规范与官方SDK，开发者现可构建标准化AI代理扩展抢占生态红利。
items.why_now_en: The article has no clear timeliness signal.
items.summary_en: Cursor plugins are standalone directories defined by a `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json` manifest, offering official integrations for productivity (Gmail, Google Workspace) and advanced developer workflows. Key capabilities include the Orchestrate plugin for parallel cloud agent execution, Thermos for deep security and correctness audits, and pstack for rigorous, high-quality code generation, alongside utilities like `create-plugin` for scaffolding new agents and `advisor` for consulting stronger models on critical decisions.

items.title: xerj-org/xerj
items.summary: XERJ 是一款兼容 Elasticsearch 的本地 AI 搜索工具，通过自动索引机制替代 grep 和 sed，可减少 40 倍的 token 消耗，主要服务于代码参考、RAG 及智能体记忆场景。实测数据显示，在保持 16/16 解决率的同时，使用 XERJ 可将编码智能体的输出 token 降低 2.7 倍，使用成本从 $11.18 降至 $3.27 以下。安装后可通过 `xerj autoindex` 命令将智能体接入 Claude Code 或 Cursor，利用其“参考编程”能力克隆并索引相关开源仓库，从而复用已有解决方案以提升开发效率。
items.why_now: XERJ发布，比grep省40倍token，让廉价小模型在参考编程中超越昂贵模型。
items.why_now_en: Local AI search replaces token-heavy grep workflows today.
items.summary_en: XERJ is a local AI search tool that indexes code and documentation using 40x fewer tokens than grep, enabling "reference coding" where agents clone and query relevant open-source repositories to guide their own code generation. In a controlled study across 16 runs, XERJ reduced output token usage by 2.7x and total costs to under $4.00 while maintaining a 16/16 solve rate, outperforming both memory-based models and grep-driven agents in efficiency and consistency.

items.title: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
items.summary: 该开源框架基于 Claude Code 构建，通过 /scrape、/apply 和 /interview 工作流实现本地化求职自动化，支持简历定制、求职信撰写及面试准备。开发者利用此工具处理了 69 份定制申请，获得 20 次面试机会并成功入职 AI 工程师职位。框架核心工作流具备语言与地域无关性，但内置的职位搜索技能主要适配丹麦市场，需依赖 Claude 订阅或 API 密钥及 LaTeX 环境运行。
items.why_now_en: Built on Claude Code, it targets a new wave of AI hiring in 2026.

items.title: I sold a voice AI agent for 20K to my FIRST BIG CLIENT
items.summary: 开发者为一家电商公司构建基于Gnani流式API的多语言语音AI智能体，以20,000美元的首付及每月3,000美元的维护费成交，该方案利用websocket处理印地语、泰米尔语及英语混码通话，并将呼叫丢失率从40%降至10%以下，65%的通话无需人工干预即可解决。
items.why_now_en: Gnani's one-stream code-switching API enables fast, affordable multilingual support.

items.title: Lovable Supabase: Bring Your Own Project
items.summary: Lovable通过连接用户自有的Supabase项目实现“Bring Your Own Project”，该集成需由工作区管理员链接组织、编辑权限者连接具体项目，且Lovable会在Git中生成可追溯的SQL迁移文件和自动重新生成TypeScript类型。相比Lovable Cloud，自有Supabase连接模式缺失了托管备份、实例调整、Cloud发送的认证邮件、托管Google登录/SAML SSO、已登录浏览器测试及PII扫描等功能，但提升了数据透明度与迁移控制能力。
items.why_now: Lovable 新推 Supabase 自带项目功能，实现本地化部署与 Git 迁移管理。
items.summary_en: Connecting a custom Supabase project to Lovable requires a two-step process: a workspace admin links the organization, and an editor connects the specific project, a process that ideally should occur at the start since Lovable lacks one-click migration tools. Once connected, Lovable manages schema changes as approved SQL migrations, deploys edge functions with secure secret storage, and automates authentication, while critical features like managed backups, RLS security checks, and in-editor database views remain exclusive to Lovable Cloud.

items.title: Investor relations data for AI agents: prepping Netflix's 20 October earnings with an MCP server
items.summary: Equibles 构建的 MCP 服务器通过聚合 IR 日历、指引历史和演示文稿等分散数据，利用 ListInvestorEvents 和 GetGuidance 等接口将 Netflix 财报准备工作从多标签页操作简化为单次 AI 对话。该系统成功追踪了 Netflix 2026 财年的动态指引变化，包括营收区间从 50.7-51.7B 收窄至 51.0-51.4B，以及自由现金流目标在 4 月从 11B 上调至 12.5B。此外，工具还通过 GetEarningsCallToneAndThemes 量化了管理层语调的显著降温（从 Q1 的 78 降至 Q2 的 65），并支持获取幻灯片元数据以节省上下文窗口。
items.why_now: Equibles MCP发布，AI代理可一键汇总Netflix 10月20日财报及历史指引。
items.summary_en: Equibles, a stock market data MCP server, provides a unified interface for AI agents to automate pre-earnings preparation by retrieving IR calendars, guidance history, and slide metadata. For Netflix's Q3 2026 report, the system aggregates specific metrics such as 2026 revenue guidance of $50.7B–$51.4B and a 33.2% Q3 operating margin, while also tracking guidance adjustments like a $1.5B increase in free cash flow targets. The tool exposes REST-based links for full slide decks and analyzes investor relations news and sentiment, including a drop in management tone from 78 to 65 between Q1 and Q2.

items.title: Show HN: PrimerKit, financial market work at agent speed
items.why_now_en: Open-source agent tool for live market data.
items.summary_en: PrimerKit is an open-source workspace that connects AI agents like Claude Code or Codex to real-time financial market data from PreReason, enabling users to test custom rules against historical data and place paper orders. The tool operates via plain-language commands or keyboard shortcuts (e.g., /digest, /compare) within a user's existing terminal, maintaining a local journal of every run to enhance transparency over standard AI responses.

items.title: Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and is spending more time in meetings
items.why_now: 刚发布的报告披露初级技术岗占比骤降至9%，预示2025年起初级开发就业窗口正在加速关闭。
items.why_now_en: Junior tech roles at AI leaders shrank 67% since early 2025.
items.summary_en: Anthropic's latest report indicates that junior technical hires dropped from 27% to 9% and technical staff composition fell from 61% to 56%, as coding tools enable non-technical employees to build software. While productivity metrics improved through increased code output and sales efficiency, meeting time rose by 20% overall due to a new "human attention and judgment" bottleneck where employees spend significant effort managing and organizing outputs from Claude.

items.title: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
items.why_now: Replit周四官宣弃用Anthropic转投OpenAI，默认模型变更即刻重塑独立开发者工具选型。
items.why_now_en: Anthropic's default status at Replit is gone now.
items.summary_en: Replit switched its default AI model from Anthropic to OpenAI’s ChatGPT, citing superior performance in internal benchmarks for building vibe-coded applications and better cost-efficiency, while retaining optional access to Claude models. CEO Amjad Masad reported that enterprise revenue expanded from 2% to 15% of total sales, with over 50% now derived from B2B contracts, and projected that more than half of the company’s revenue will come from enterprise and government clients by 2027.

items.title: 谢赛宁昔日实习生创业，接手复活Sora，进军好莱坞
Show HN: Photos to Gaussian Splat inside your browser using DA3 Small
items.summary: DA3 Small 技术将照片转换为高斯泼溅（Gaussian Splat）的渲染功能集成到了 splatting-rs 库中，并支持在浏览器内直接运行。该方案无需依赖本地重型软件，即可在网页端完成从二维图像到三维场景的重建与交互体验。
items.summary_en: The open-source project splatting-rs enables in-browser conversion of photographs into Gaussian Splatting 3D scenes by running the DA3 Small model via WebAssembly. This client-side tool eliminates the need for server infrastructure, allowing users to generate 3D visualizations directly within their web browsers.

items.title: DeepSeek: DeepSeek v4.1 Flash 1017
items.summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 是基于 CED 架构的稀疏混合专家模型，通过 552B 参数的骨干网络在输入激活 8B、输出激活 16B 的非对称参数分配，实现了原生图像理解及极低单 token 计算成本。其压缩 KV 缓存技术将代理工作负载的缓存内存占用削减至前代 Flash 的四分之一，在性能、速度及任务完成时间上全面超越 V4 Pro，专为编码、终端及长视野智能体应用设计。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (October 17, 2026 snapshot) is a sparse mixture-of-experts model utilizing a 552B-parameter Causal Encoder-Decoder backbone that activates 8B parameters for input and 16B for output. The model features native image understanding through jointly trained visual and text embeddings, while compressed KV caching reduces cache memory by roughly 75% compared to the previous Flash generation. Positioned as the cost-efficient tier of the V4.1 family, it outperforms V4 Pro in performance, speed, and task completion time for coding, terminal, and long-horizon agentic workloads.

items.title: DeepSeek-v4.1-Flash-1017
items.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 作为 Minor 更新，显著提升了推理、编码及智能体任务表现，同时通过缩短执行时间与输出长度优化了性能-成本帕累托前沿。该模型未包含 Jinja 聊天模板，而是提供自包含的 Python 参考实现及 Rust 库 deepseek-recipe，支持将 Messages 等请求转换为 DeepSeek V4/V4.1 提示格式，涵盖思考模式、工具调用及图像内容处理。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a minor update that improves performance in reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks while reducing execution time and output length to lower costs. The release excludes a Jinja chat template, instead providing a self-contained Python reference implementation for prompt encoding and the deepseek-recipe Rust toolkit, which handles protocol-aware prompt conversion and response parsing for production environments.

items.title: The Silent Costs of AI APIs Nobody Warns You About
items.summary_en: Building AI-driven applications incurs hidden costs beyond advertised per-token rates, primarily due to the "context window tax" where full conversation histories multiply token usage and rate limits that cause production failures. Implementing a context summarizer to condense history can reduce API costs by 60%, while developers must also account for engineering time spent writing custom retry-with-backoff loops to manage 429 errors and model-specific throughput restrictions.

items.title: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
items.summary: Meta 更新了商业使用条款，曾授予其抓取拥有 Meta 商业账户的出版商网站内容用于 AI 模型训练，但遭法律专家质疑及媒体曝光后迅速撤回该条款。Meta 声明此举仅适用于广告和商业产品，澄清其网络爬虫的实际使用方式并未发生改变。

directions.name: RiskFlow Reviewer
directions.description: 基于风险分级和增量Diff的自动化代码评审辅助插件，解决AI代码生成后的评审瓶颈
directions.description_en: An automated code review helper plugin based on risk classification and incremental diffs, solving the review bottleneck after AI code generation
directions.target_user: 使用Copilot/Claude Code等AI工具开发代码的小团队或独立开发者
directions.target_user_en: Small teams or solo developers using AI tools like Copilot/Claude Code
core_features: 仅展示增量变更的Diff视图
AI预检通过后才推送到人类评审者
core_features_en: Incremental diff view showing only changes
AI pre-check before pushing to human reviewers
directions.why_now: Anthropic最近披露Claude Code 90%代码由AI生成，导致评审流程严重过载；社区热议如何通过‘风险分级’和‘增量Diff’将平均评审轮次从2.08降至1.32。现在开发者迫切需要工具来区分哪些AI生成的代码需要深度人工审查，哪些可以自动化通过，以降低Revert率和评审疲劳。
directions.why_now_en: Anthropic revealed that 90% of Claude Code's code is AI-generated, causing severe review bottlenecks. Community discussions highlight that 'risk classification' and 'incremental diffs' reduced review cycles from 2.08 to 1.32. Developers now urgently need tools to determine which AI code requires deep human review and which can be automated, to reduce revert rates and review fatigue.
directions.monetization: SaaS 订阅模式，按团队成员数收费；提供开源社区版吸引流量，企业版支持自定义风险规则和与GitLab/GitHub的深度集成
directions.monetization_en: SaaS subscription based on team size; open-source community version for traffic, enterprise version for custom risk rules and deep GitLab/GitHub integration
